# Discord

> Connect Zenflow to Discord to send messages, monitor channels, and automate server communications.

<span className="set-page-badge-native" />

<Note>
  This native integration requires a Zencoder account.
</Note>

## Overview

The Discord integration lets the AI agent interact with your Discord server. Send messages, monitor channels, post updates, and automate communication workflows — all from within a Zenflow task.

## Connecting Discord

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open Settings & Integrations">
    Navigate to **Settings → Integrations** in the Zenflow sidebar.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Find Discord">
    Locate **Discord** in the Integrations Catalog.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Click Connect">
    Click the **Connect** or **\[+]** button on the Discord card.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Authorize Connection">
    Authenticate and authorize Zenflow to access your Discord server via the secure OAuth popup window.
  </Step>
</Steps>

## What the Agent Can Do

* **Send messages** — Post messages to channels and threads
* **Read channels** — Monitor channel activity and message history
* **Post updates** — Share status updates, alerts, and summaries to designated channels
* **Manage threads** — Reply to threads and track conversations

## Example Use Cases

* Post deployment notifications to a dev-ops channel
* Send daily standup summaries to a team channel
* Surface urgent alerts from monitoring tools
* Automate community engagement responses

Browse ready-to-use templates in the **[Zencoder Marketplace](https://zencoder.ai/marketplace)**.
